shared_elements: low relief carving on a flat stone surface
horizontal register or band organizing the composition
a row of repeated figures side by side
raised-edge framing of the carved field
justification: Both are low-relief carved surfaces with profile figures aligned along horizontal registers, and both use a repeated row of similar figures, but that is a generic compositional habit rather than a shared motif. A shows animals — quadrupeds, a bird-like creature with a long neck, a snake-like/ram-headed form and abstract signs — whereas B shows a procession of robed, bearded human figures carrying bowls and vessels toward a staff-holding figure; no specific creature, attribute or relationship corresponds.
